```{r }
url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uctK0JUrazXonQsA-Drt70Vwbv6JnfiKOoGIpcJGGMI/edit?gid=644660855#gid=644660855"

gs <- as_sheets_id(url)

fb <- range_read(gs, sheet = "fb") %>% 
  mutate(across(cce_12_1:ncol(.), ~ as.character(.))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(1:TREATMENT)) %>% 
  separate(name, c("name", "pheno", "sample")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(pheno)) %>% 
  pivot_wider() %>% 
  mutate(across(c(1:sample), as.factor)) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

quali <- fb %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(1:sample, cce,tcvmfp, pv, cva,cv,cvmf, ph, cvs, fs,cda, Cpe, pcs, csco,cscc)) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(CHECKS, "1"))

quali <- quali %>%
  mutate(across(
    c( cce,tcvmfp, pv, cva,cv,cvmf, ph, cvs, fs,cda, Cpe, pcs, csco,cscc),  
    ~ gsub("^\\d+\\s*", "", .)  
  )) %>%
  mutate(across(
    c( cce,tcvmfp, pv, cva,cv,cvmf, ph, cvs, fs,cda, Cpe, pcs, csco,cscc),  
    ~ iconv(., from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")  
  )) %>%
  mutate(across(
    c( cce,tcvmfp, pv, cva,cv,cvmf, ph, cvs, fs,cda, Cpe, pcs, csco,cscc),
    ~ str_replace_all(., 
                      c("Ãº" = "ú", 
                        "Ã³" = "ó", 
                        "Ã" = "Á", 
                        "A3" = "o"))
  ))
```


# Descriptors
```{r}
info <- range_read(gs, sheet = "descriptor") %>%
  rename_with(~ iconv(.x, from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace_all(.x, "^[^a-zA-Z0-9]+|[^a-zA-Z0-9]+$", "")) %>%
  tidyr::fill(c(abbreviatio_sp , abbreviatio_en, descriptors), .direction = "down")
```


# Objective 1

## Study of the morphological diversity of qualitative variables in beans accessions

### Rasgos cualitativos (Na), Numero efectivo de clases(Ne), Diversidad genetica de Nei(He) y Shannon–Weaver diversity index (H′)

```{r }

qt <- quali %>%
  dplyr::select(cce, tcvmfp, pv, cva, cv, cvmf, ph, cvs, fs, cda, Cpe, pcs, csco, cscc) %>%
  drop_na()

vars <- names(qt)

labs <- info %>%
  filter(abbreviatio_sp %in% vars) %>%
  dplyr::select(abbreviatio_sp, descriptors) %>%
  deframe()

sum_q <- function(df, v, lab) {
  tb <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
    count(.data[[v]], name = "Na") %>%
    mutate(fi = Na / sum(Na))
  
  Nc <- nrow(tb)
  p2 <- sum(tb$fi^2)
  Ne <- 1 / p2
  He <- 1 - p2
  Hp <- vegan::diversity(tb$Na, index = "shannon")
  
  tb %>%
    rename(cat_es = all_of(v)) %>%
    left_join(
      info %>%
        dplyr::select(cat_es, cat_en) %>%
        distinct(cat_es, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = "cat_es"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      `Qualitative trait` = lab,
      `Phenotypic classes observed` = dplyr::coalesce(cat_en, as.character(cat_es)),
      Nc = Nc,
      Ne = Ne,
      He = He,
      Hp = Hp
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      `Qualitative trait`,
      `Phenotypic classes observed`,
      Na, fi, Nc, Ne, He, Hp
    )
}

qtb <- map_dfr(
  vars,
  ~ sum_q(qt, v = .x, lab = labs[.x])
)

res <- qtb %>%
  distinct(`Qualitative trait`, Nc, Ne, He, Hp)

avg <- res %>%
  summarise(
    Nc_m  = mean(Nc, na.rm = TRUE),
    Nc_se = sd(Nc, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Nc))),
    Ne_m  = mean(Ne, na.rm = TRUE),
    Ne_se = sd(Ne, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Ne))),
    He_m  = mean(He, na.rm = TRUE),
    He_se = sd(He, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(He))),
    Hp_m  = mean(Hp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hp_se = sd(Hp, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Hp)))
  )

out <- qtb %>%
  mutate(across(c(fi, Nc, Ne, He, Hp), ~ round(., 2))) %>%
  rename(`H′` = Hp)

fmt <- out %>%
  group_by(`Qualitative trait`) %>%
  mutate(
    Na = as.character(Na),
    fi = sprintf("%.2f", fi),
    Nc = if_else(row_number() == 1, sprintf("%.2f", Nc), ""),
    Ne = if_else(row_number() == 1, sprintf("%.2f", Ne), ""),
    He = if_else(row_number() == 1, sprintf("%.2f", He), ""),
    `H′` = if_else(row_number() == 1, sprintf("%.2f", `H′`), ""),
    `Qualitative trait` = if_else(row_number() == 1, `Qualitative trait`, "")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

mrow <- avg %>%
  transmute(
    `Qualitative trait` = "Mean ± SE",
    `Phenotypic classes observed` = "",
    Na = "",
    fi = "",
    Nc = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", Nc_m, Nc_se),
    Ne = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", Ne_m, Ne_se),
    He = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", He_m, He_se),
    `H′` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", Hp_m, Hp_se)
  )

Diversity <- fmt %>%
  mutate(across(c(Nc, Ne, He, `H′`), as.character)) %>%
  bind_rows(mrow)

Diversity %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Shannon–Weaver diversity index (H′)")

write_xlsx(Diversity, "manuscript/Table-1.xlsx")

cor_matrix <- res %>%
  dplyr::select(Nc, Ne, He, Hp) %>%
  drop_na()

psych::pairs.panels(
  cor_matrix,
  method = "spearman",
  hist.col = "red",
  pch = 21,
  stars = TRUE,
  scale = FALSE,
  lm = TRUE
)
```

# Objective 2

## Study of the morphological diversity of quantitative variables of quinoa accessions and variables with the greatest discriminant contribution

```{r }
quanti <- fb %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(1:sample, ap50f,ap50m, dt, spad, nrfp, df, dflo, lv, vp, dhm, spv, av, ps, ls, as, rp)) 

exp <- quanti%>%
  mutate(geno = case_when(
    CHECKS == 0 ~ as.character(CODIGO)
    , CHECKS == 1 ~ "CHECKS"
  ), .after = CHECKS) %>% 
  mutate(across(c(1:sample), as.factor)) %>% 
  mutate(across(c(ap50f,ap50m, dt, spad, nrfp, df, dflo, lv, vp, dhm, spv, av, ps, ls, as, rp), as.numeric)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(1:sample, ap50f,ap50m, dt, spad, nrfp, df, dflo, lv, vp, dhm, spv, av, ps, ls, as, rp) 

```

### Augmented design with entries as random effects and checks as fixed effects

Model: y ~ 0 + (1|BLOCK) + (1|ROW) + (1|COLUMN) + (1|CODIGO:CHECKS) + geno



```{r }
rslt <- 15:length(exp) %>% map(\(x) {
  
trait <- names(exp)[x]

exp %>% 
  drop_na(trait)%>% 
  H2cal(trait = trait
    , gen.name = "geno"
    , rep.n = 2
    , fixed.model = ~ 0 + (1|BLOCK) + (1|ROW) + (1|COLUMN) + (1|CODIGO:CHECKS) + geno
    , random.model = ~ 1 + (1|BLOCK) + (1|ROW) + (1|COLUMN) + (1|CODIGO:CHECKS) + (1|geno)
    , summary = TRUE
    , emmeans = FALSE
    , plot_diag = T
    , outliers.rm = FALSE
    )

})
tabsmr <- 1:length(rslt) %>% map(\(x) {
      rslt[[x]][["tabsmr"]] 
      }) %>% 
  bind_rows()

blues <- 1:length(rslt) %>% map(\(x) {
      rslt[[x]][["blues"]] %>% dplyr::select(!matches("smith.w"))
      }) %>% Reduce(function(...) merge(..., all = TRUE
                                        , by = c('geno')), .)

blups <- 1:length(rslt) %>% map(\(x) {
      rslt[[x]][["blups"]] %>% dplyr::select(!matches("smith.w"))
      }) %>% Reduce(function(...) merge(..., all = TRUE
                                        , by = c('geno')), .)

blues %>% web_table()
```


# Multivariate Analysis using BLUEs
   
```{r }
map_nm <- setNames(info$abbreviatio_en, info$abbreviatio_sp)

ren <- setNames(
  names(map_nm[names(map_nm) %in% names(blues)]),
  map_nm[names(map_nm) %in% names(blues)]
)

blues <- blues %>% rename(!!!ren)

blues <- blues %>% 
  slice(-1) %>%
mutate(geno = str_remove(geno, "^UNTRM11"))

mv <- blues%>% 
  column_to_rownames("geno") %>% 
  PCA(scale.unit = T, graph = F)

pcavar <- mv %>% 
  plot.PCA(choix="var"
           , title=""
           , autoLab = "y"
           ,  cex = 0.8
           , shadowtext = T)

pcaind <- mv %>% 
  plot.PCA(choix="ind"
           , habillage =10
           , title=""
           , autoLab = "y"
           , cex = 0.8
           , shadowtext = T
           , label = "ind"
           )

list(pcavar, pcaind) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., nrow = 1, labels = "AUTO"
            , rel_heights = c(1, 1.1)
            )

hcpc <- HCPC(mv, graph = FALSE)

tree <- \() {
  plot.HCPC(hcpc,
          choice = "map",
          legend = list(x = "topright",
                        cex = 0.6,
                        inset = 0.001,
                        box.lty = 0),
          draw.tree = FALSE)
  
}

plot <- plot_grid(pcavar, tree,
                  nrow = 1, labels = "auto")
p <- plot %>%
  ggsave2(plot = .
          , "manuscript/Figure.jpg"
          , units = "cm", width = 35, height = 20)

p %>% include_graphics()

# Analisis de correlación 
cuanti_matrix <- blues %>% 
  dplyr::select(2:ncol(blues))


grid <- \() {
  
  pairs.panels(cuanti_matrix,
             method = "spearman",   
             hist.col = "red",      
             pch = 21,             
             stars = T,        
             scale = F,
             lm = T)  
  
}

pg <- grid %>% 
  plot_grid()

plot <- ggsave(filename = "manuscript/Figure_.jpg"
               , width = 30
               , height = 30
               , units = "cm")
```


# Tabla 2: Presents descriptive statistics for the quantitative traits evaluated in the blues dataset. For each trait, the table reports the mean, minimum, maximum, and coefficient of variation (CV%), providing a summary of the central tendency, range, and relative variability of the measured characteristics.

```{r, echo=FALSE}

en <- info$abbreviatio_en
des<- info$descriptors
bluesmeans <-blues 
n <- setNames(des, en)
nb <- n[names(n) %in% colnames(bluesmeans)]
original <- setNames(names(nb),nb)
bluesmeans <- bluesmeans %>% rename(!!!original)
bluesmeans

rl <- bluesmeans %>%
  dplyr::select(c(2:13)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(.x < 0, 0, .x))) %>%
  summarise(across(
    everything(),
    list(
      Mean = ~round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Min  = ~round(min(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Max  = ~round(max(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      `CV(%)` = ~round(sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 2)
    )
  )) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Quantitative trait", "stat"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = stat,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(Min:`CV(%)`, ~formatC(.x, format = "f", digits = 2))) 

rl%>% web_table()
write_xlsx(rl, "manuscript/Table-2.xlsx")

```

# Supplementary material
## Figure 1: The figure shows a principal component analysis (PCA), where (a) displays the correlation between variables and components, (b) the percentage of variance explained by each dimension, and (c–d) the variables contributing most to dimensions 1 and 2, allowing identification of the most influential variables in the data structure.

```{r }
library(corrplot)

var <- get_pca_var(mv)

tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
ppi <- 300
png(tmp, width=4*ppi, height=12*ppi, res=ppi)
corrplot(var$cor, 
         method="number",
         tl.col="black", 
         tl.srt=45)
graphics.off()

pt1 <- png::readPNG(tmp) %>%
  grid::rasterGrob(interpolate = TRUE)

pt2 <- fviz_eig(mv, 
                addlabels=TRUE,
                hjust = 0.05,
                barfill="white",
                barcolor ="darkblue",
                linecolor ="red") + 
  ylim(0, 45) +  
  labs(
    title = "PCA - percentage of explained variances",
    y = "Variance (%)") +
  theme_minimal()

pt3 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 1, 
                     top = 10,
                     fill = "white",
                     color = "darkblue",
                     sort.val = "desc") +
  ylim(0, 25) + 
  labs(title = "Dim 1 - variables contribution")


pt4 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 2, 
                     top = 10,
                     fill = "white",
                     color = "darkblue",
                     sort.val = "desc") +
  ylim(0, 30) +  
  labs(title = "Dim 2 - variables contribution")

plot <- ggdraw(xlim = c(0.0, 1.0), ylim = c(0, 1.0)) +
  draw_plot(pt1,  width = 0.4, height = 1.1, x = 0.6, y = -0.05) +  
  draw_plot(pt2,  width = 0.6, height = 0.34, x = 0.03, y = 0.66) +
  draw_plot(pt3, width = 0.6, height = 0.34, x = 0.03, y = 0.33) + 
  draw_plot(pt4, width = 0.6, height = 0.34, x = 0.03, y = 0.0) +
  draw_plot_label(
    label = c("a", "b", "c", "d"),
    x = c(0.005, 0.005, 0.005, 0.65),
    y = c(0.999, 0.67, 0.34, 0.999))

print(plot)

pt <- ggsave2(plot = plot, "files/SFigure-1.jpg", height = 25, width = 35, units = "cm")

pt %>% include_graphics()
```

# Tabla sumplemetaria 1
```{r }
library(stringr)

quali2 <- quali %>%
  dplyr::select(CODIGO, cce, tcvmfp, pv, cva, cv, cvmf, ph, cvs, fs, cda, Cpe, pcs, csco, cscc) %>%
  filter(if_any(-CODIGO, ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  mutate(CODIGO = str_sub(CODIGO, -4)) %>%
  distinct(CODIGO, .keep_all = TRUE)

map_nm <- setNames(info$abbreviatio_en, info$abbreviatio_sp)

ren <- setNames(
  names(map_nm[names(map_nm) %in% names(quali2)]),
  map_nm[names(map_nm) %in% names(quali2)]
)

quali2 <- quali2 %>% rename(!!!ren)

blues2 <- blues %>%
  mutate(CODIGO = str_sub(geno, -4)) %>%
  dplyr::select(CODIGO, PHF,PHM, SD, SPAD, NFRP, DF, FD, PL, PPP, DPM, SPP, PW, SW, SL, SWD, YPP) %>%
  distinct(CODIGO, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
 mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

# Table supplementary 1 -----------------------------------
Tabla1 <- fb %>%
  dplyr::select(CODIGO) %>%
  mutate(CODIGO = str_sub(CODIGO, -4)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(quali2, by = "CODIGO") %>%
  left_join(blues2, by = "CODIGO") %>%
  mutate(flag = CODIGO %in% c("CH1", "CH2")) %>%
  arrange(flag, CODIGO) %>%
  dplyr::select(-flag)

# DATA CHEKS----------------------------------------------------

  dplyr::select(CODIGO, ap50f, ap50m, dt, spad, nrfp, df, dflo, lv, vp, dhm, spv, av, ps, ls, as, rp)

map_nm <- setNames(info$abbreviatio_en, info$abbreviatio_sp)

  map_nm[names(map_nm) %in% names(quanti_ch)]
)

quanti_ch <- quanti_ch %>% dplyr::rename(!!!ren)

  dplyr::select(CODIGO, cce, tcvmfp, pv, cva, cv, cvmf, ph, cvs, fs, cda, Cpe, pcs, csco, cscc) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n_no_na = rowSums(!is.na(across(-CODIGO)))) %>%

  mutate(across(

    ~ gsub("^\\d+\\s*", "", .)  
  )) %>%
  mutate(across(
    c( cce,tcvmfp, pv, cva,cv,cvmf, ph, cvs, fs,cda, Cpe, pcs, csco,cscc),  
    ~ iconv(., from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")  
  )) %>%
  mutate(across(
    c( cce,tcvmfp, pv, cva,cv,cvmf, ph, cvs, fs,cda, Cpe, pcs, csco,cscc),
    ~ str_replace_all(., 
                      c("Ãº" = "ú", 
                        "Ã³" = "ó", 
                        "Ã" = "Á", 
                        "A3" = "o"))
  ))

map_nm <- setNames(info$abbreviatio_en, info$abbreviatio_sp)

ren <- setNames(

  map_nm[names(map_nm) %in% names(fb_ch)]
)

fb_ch <- fb_ch %>% dplyr::rename(!!!ren)
#----------------------------------------------------------

quanti_ch2 <- quanti_ch %>%
  mutate(CODIGO = as.character(CODIGO))

Tabla1 <- Tabla1 %>%
  mutate(CODIGO = as.character(CODIGO))%>%
  rows_update(quanti_ch2, by = "CODIGO") %>%
```
